Counsel

Joel Denaro

Joel M. Denaro is a Miami-based criminal defense trial attorney with more than twenty-five years of experience representing clients in state and federal courts throughout South Florida. As managing partner of Joel Denaro P.A., he is known for bringing strategic precision, discretion and disciplined advocacy to complex and sensitive criminal matters.

His practice spans the full spectrum of criminal defense, including DUI and drug-related charges, serious felony offenses, white-collar fraud, federal investigations and RICO prosecutions. Denaro regularly represents clients in matters involving significant legal, financial and reputational exposure, guiding them through every stage of the process — from investigation and pretrial strategy through negotiation and trial.

Recognized for his direct, highly focused approach, Denaro builds each defense around the specific facts, risks and objectives of the client. Regardless of the size or profile of the matter, he brings the same intensity, preparation and commitment to protecting his clients' rights.

Denaro has been a member of The Florida Bar since 1999 and is a graduate of New York Law School. His firm has also been recognized in the 2026 edition of Best Law Firms for Criminal Defense: General Practice and Criminal Defense: White-Collar in the Miami metropolitan market.

Courtney Lynn Denaro
Family Law Attorney  ·  Joel Denaro, P.A.

Courtney Lynn Denaro is a licensed family law attorney based in Miami, Florida. A graduate of Brooklyn Law School (J.D., 2001) and the University of Vermont (B.S., 1992), she has been a member of The Florida Bar for over twenty-five years. Courtney practices at Joel Denaro, P.A., where she brings the same commitment to clients navigating complex family law matters.

Notable Cases
2024 – PresentMiami Herald · NBC News · Law & Crime
United States v. Alexander Brothers — Federal Sex Trafficking Defense

Joel Denaro represents co-defendant Sean Fishman in the high-profile federal prosecution of Oren and Alon Alexander, Miami luxury real estate developers charged with sex trafficking and rape. One of the most widely covered federal criminal trials in South Florida history.

2022 – PresentMiami Herald
State v. Pino — Biscayne Bay Vessel Homicide

Representing the family of Lucy Fernandez, a 17-year-old Our Lady of Lourdes Academy student killed when George Pino's boat struck a channel marker in Biscayne Bay in 2022. Denaro's work surfacing a critical new witness directly led prosecutors to upgrade charges to felony vessel homicide. Trial set for June 2026.

2018Miami Herald
Scurtis v. Rodriguez — A-Rod Real Estate Dispute

Co-counsel for Constantine Scurtis, ex-brother-in-law of Alex Rodriguez, in a high-profile civil dispute over a billion-dollar real estate venture spanning approximately 5,000 units across dozens of limited liability partnerships.

2011Miami Herald · Florida Supreme Court
Florida v. Caraballo — Death Sentence Overturned

Secured a 6-1 Florida Supreme Court ruling overturning the death sentence of Victor Caraballo, convicted in the 2002 South Beach kidnapping, rape, and murder of Ana Maria Angel. The court held that expert psychiatric testimony in the penalty phase was improperly admitted.

"The state got a bit greedy in their presentation of the evidence and led the judge down the wrong path. But there are no winners in this case."
2010Miami Herald
United States v. Prada — Colombian Cartel Mistrial

Co-counsel in the federal prosecution of Hernan Prada, alleged head of a Colombian cocaine trafficking enterprise. When the jury deadlocked, Denaro and co-counsel William Barzee requested a non-unanimous majority verdict. The jury stood 7-5 for acquittal. The prosecution declined, forcing a mistrial.

"Our instinct was right. It would have been spectacular if they had agreed. It was really intense."
2009Miami Herald · The Ledger
State v. Cronin — Charges Dropped

Defended Sean Cronin, a Miami federal prosecutor, against misdemeanor charges following his arrest at a Miami River bar. Denaro challenged the arrest from the outset, and prosecutors ultimately dropped all charges citing lack of evidence.

"He went swimming in his boxer shorts, for God's sake. He did nothing wrong."

Abogado

Joel Denaro

Joel M. Denaro es abogado penalista en Miami con más de veinticinco años de experiencia representando a clientes en tribunales estatales y federales en todo el sur de la Florida. Como socio director de Joel Denaro P.A., es reconocido por su precisión estratégica, discreción y defensa disciplinada en asuntos penales complejos y delicados.

Su práctica abarca todo el espectro de la defensa penal, incluyendo cargos por DUI y delitos relacionados con drogas, delitos graves, fraude de cuello blanco, investigaciones federales y procesos bajo la ley RICO. Denaro representa con regularidad a clientes en asuntos con alta exposición legal, financiera y reputacional, acompañándolos en cada etapa del proceso — desde la investigación y la estrategia previa al juicio hasta la negociación y el juicio oral.

Reconocido por su enfoque directo y altamente concentrado, Denaro estructura cada defensa en torno a los hechos específicos, los riesgos y los objetivos del cliente. Sin importar el tamaño o el perfil del asunto, aporta la misma intensidad, preparación y compromiso en la protección de los derechos de sus clientes.

Denaro es miembro del Colegio de Abogados de Florida desde 1999 y graduado de New York Law School. Su firma también ha sido reconocida en la edición 2026 de Best Law Firms en las categorías de Defensa Penal: Práctica General y Defensa Penal: Cuello Blanco en el mercado metropolitano de Miami.

Casos Destacados
2024 – PresenteMiami Herald · NBC News · Law & Crime
Estados Unidos v. Hermanos Alexander — Defensa Federal por Tráfico Sexual

Joel Denaro representa al co-acusado Sean Fishman en la resonante causa federal contra Oren y Alon Alexander, empresarios inmobiliarios de lujo en Miami acusados de tráfico sexual y violación. Uno de los procesos penales federales más seguidos en la historia del sur de la Florida.

2022 – PresenteMiami Herald
Estado v. Pino — Homicidio en Embarcación en la Bahía Biscayne

Representa a la familia de Lucy Fernández, estudiante de 17 años de la Academia Our Lady of Lourdes fallecida cuando la lancha de George Pino colisionó con una boya en la Bahía Biscayne en 2022. La gestión de Denaro para localizar a un testigo clave llevó a la fiscalía a elevar los cargos a homicidio náutico grave. Juicio previsto para junio de 2026.

2011Miami Herald · Tribunal Supremo de Florida
Florida v. Caraballo — Pena de Muerte Revocada

Obtuvo una resolución del Tribunal Supremo de Florida, con fallo de 6 a 1, que anuló la condena a muerte de Victor Caraballo por el secuestro, violación y asesinato de Ana Maria Angel en South Beach en 2002. El tribunal determinó que el testimonio psiquiátrico en la fase de sentencia fue admitido de forma improcedente.

"El Estado se extralimitó en la presentación de pruebas y llevó al juez por el camino equivocado. Pero en este caso no hay ganadores."
2010Miami Herald
Estados Unidos v. Prada — Juicio Nulo en Causa Federal de Narcotráfico

Co-defensor en el proceso federal contra Hernán Prada, presunto líder de una organización colombiana de tráfico de cocaína. Ante el empate del jurado, Denaro y su colega William Barzee solicitaron un veredicto por mayoría simple. El conteo fue de 7 a 5 a favor de la absolución. La fiscalía rechazó la propuesta, resultando en un juicio nulo.

"Nuestro instinto era correcto. Hubiera sido espectacular que aceptaran. Fue muy intenso."
